question.text: YTM 6%, annual coupon Rs. 80, face Rs. 1,000, 4 years. Price (approx):

explanation.text: The Logic: PV = 80*(annuity factor 4y @ 6%) + 1000/(1.06^4) = 80*3.4651 + 1000*0.7921 = 277.21 + 792.09 = Rs. 1,069.30. The Trap: Rs. 969 would imply a discount; coupon > YTM means premium. Cross-Exam Context: Standard bond pricing.
